new_hits.quote_note: 引用他自己此前关于镁摄入不足、开始补 Magnesium Glycinate 的长文：日摄入约 200mg，建议 420mg，约六成人群缺镁。
new_hits.quoted_text:
Talked with my clanker and based on my nutrition I get about 200mg of magnesium per day

You need to get about 420mg per day, so I'm slightly deficient

About 60% of people are magnesium deficient and symptoms can be anxiety (and in turn bad sleep) because magnesium helps your brain regulate your nervous system and stress hormones like cortisol

I don't have any issues (no anxiety, no depression at all, mostly because regular gym and clean nutrition) but maybe good to take it to become even more chill

So I got Magnesium Glycinate supplements

I'll report back on the benefits! 😊 

One thing interesting is yeaaaars ago when I had lots of anxiety (before I started going gym and eating clean) I remember taking magnesium and my anxiety just disappeared, so it def works!
new_hits.quoted_text_zh: 他引用了自己之前的帖：根据营养摄入每天大约只有 200mg 镁，而建议约 420mg，略有不足；约六成人群缺镁，可能影响睡眠与焦虑，因此开始补 Magnesium Glycinate。

posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
At least 85 people this year died from Spanish train accidents, and likely it will grow to 100 at the end of this day

Very tragic and this makes Spanish trains one of the most dangerous modes of transport now

~100x more dangerous than flying commercial

~40x more dangerous than non-Spanish trains

And every trip is nopw as dangerous as jumping from a plane and skydiving

Two highly deadly train accidents in one year, that's so extreme and unlikely that it makes it at as dangerous as flying one of the most deadly airlines in the world, the Nepalese Yeti Airlines that keeps crashing due to the mountainous terrain

Pretty exceptional in a bad way
posts.text_zh:
今年至少已有 85 人死于西班牙火车事故，到今天结束很可能还会涨到 100 人

非常惨痛，这让西班牙火车成了目前最危险的交通方式之一

比民航飞行危险约 100 倍

比非西班牙火车危险约 40 倍

而且每一次出行的危险程度，差不多等于从飞机上跳下去跳伞

一年里发生两起高致死率火车事故，极端到几乎不可能——危险程度已经赶上世界上最危险的航空公司之一、因山区地形频频坠毁的尼泊尔 Yeti Airlines

糟糕得相当「出格」

posts.quoted_text:
Resend bug: header values with a double quote get RFC 2047-encoded, breaking the new OTP-Token header.

➡️ Sent: OTP-Token: "123456"; origin="https://t.co/xwX4fhenj0"
⬅️ Received: Otp-Token: =?UTF-8?Q?=22123456=22...

Inboxes can't parse it. Same with raw API + latest SDK https://t.co/yzB4A9hZhu
posts.quoted_text_zh: 他此前报的 Resend bug：header 值含双引号会被 RFC 2047 编码，弄坏 OTP-Token，收件箱解析不了。
